description: Ports du département de la Manche (50) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Situation and status of ports in the department of Manche. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Ports of the department of Manche (50)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include zones portuaires, pêche, statut, plaisance, commerce, DDTM50. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
